notes.title: Update 1.3.0
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Visual bug fixed: The hook disappeared if the player died after obtaining it.
[*] Two new languages have been added: German and Italian.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.4
notes.notes: Fixed a critical bug in the options menu

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 (gamepad support!)
notes.notes:
[h2]Additions[/h2]
- Added full Gamepad support.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed a bug in the generator scene.
- Fixed a bug in mouse sensitivity.
- Fixed a bug in the pause menu.

[h2]Changes[/h2]
- Decreased music volume in the tunnel confrontation.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] VSync has been added to the screen options.
[*] The game adapts the difficulty depending on the player's deaths.
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The game icon has been changed.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented to pause the game in the last scene.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in the last scenario that allowed the player to go through the ground.
[*] Added more indications in the tunnel to make finding the exit easier.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.notes: Some critical bugs that were preventing the game from being completed have been fixed.

notes.title: Hotfix (1.0.1)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The font has been changed due to compatibility issues with some characters in the PT-BR language.
[*] Some texts have been corrected.
[/list]
